Child21600/outer22200/readback600/restore180/trace2GiB/combined16GiB/free40GiB/RSS8GiB unchanged. Aggregate model call/token ceilings stay null.

freeze.files: Exact all noncache src, vendor simulation, input data, requirements, approved configs, this protocol and prerequisite receipts; normalized per-file SHA plus controller-compatible source digest.
freeze.runtime: Python runtime plus actual CLI wrapper/executable paths, identities and SHA before/after.
freeze.git: Origin pointer only; dirty source is represented by bytes.
freeze.mapping: Frozen runs/progress link to original real paths. Only controller ROOT/DEFAULT_LEDGER/APPROVAL and budget ROOT route runtime writes; source defaults remain frozen. No ledger copy is used as a writable account.
freeze.stopped_sources: Exact original small certificate bytes copied into campaign/stopped_source, with original absolute path/identity and SHA retained; original files are rechecked at final evidence. Both copy and external original byte counts consume the same16GiB.

supervision.chain: host gate owns serial lock -> common owner-pipe outer supervisor -> separately guarded controller/readback/restore; each model call has its own existing guard.
supervision.evidence: Every successful phase requires original request/process hashes, terminal lifecycle receipt, actual completed wait and outputs pinned to first guard SHA. Missing owner/cleanup/pending evidence fails.
supervision.deadline: Preparation counted into outer allowance. Restore shares remaining readback allowance. Final certificate fsync/host return excluded from reported receipt-preparation sample and requires launching-host measurement; no claim of hard coverage for that small host tail.
supervision.memory: max command/guard process peakRSS per phase, posthoc<=8GiB; not simultaneous tree RSS and not a hard memory guard.
supervision.containment: POSIX process-group/owner-pipe containment under its documented cooperative topology; not a sandbox against arbitrary setsid/setpgid.

acceptance: Complete success only after outer actual exit, child terminal3600, all913 source coverage and full source/opportunity/physical bundle valid.

Frozen new controller replays every original action or envelope rejection with exact original schema/raw/guard/ledger/durable prefix; only explicit verified apply commits unchanged compiled.plan; no solver/constructor.

New run actual account closed; original stopped CID remains raw pending with unknown usage. Original append-only diagnosis, complete prefix/source/stop proof and same-domain suffix guard must validate.
Same-source snapshot1 hash/implementation/data/fulltrace checks plus actual exact restore without physical advance.
All first result/trace/cost/process/bundle member/ledger/checkpoint hashes survive final inventory and later readback; acceptance predicates are recomputed.

limitations: 21 new distinct installed tests and original complete ledger readonly passed; prior241 version-specific related tests were retained without rerun. This is not acceptance of the new actual B1h.
ProgressObservations is not integrated; timing leaf work counters may be absent. Original history copies/whole DB hashing still exist.
Original V4 pending and V6 finished unknown usage are retained with their complete original evidence. No new unfinished call permits another request.
All old physical/common validator, explicit apply, original guard, actual exit/full costs and independent attribution remain mandatory.
launch_requirement: Root completed exact V7 installation,21 actual tests, original full ledger readonly and independent installed review. Freeze then actual host run, original real exit, independent audits and full costs are required for acceptance. No original run retry.

progress_observation.method: Read existing completed request/response metadata, durable journal tails, timing leaves and trace append-only increments; retain small timestamped external observations. No live DB mutation or full replay while running.
valid_progress: new requested pages with distinct continuation or stated gap
new model-selected tasks or substantive edits
validation errors reduced or changed with targeted correction
explicit validated apply appearing as an actual physical trace commit
physical simulation time advances and subsequent scheduling continues
progress_observation.diagnosis_trigger: Three consecutive completed responses repeating the same request or same validation error without new useful content, or 15 minutes without substantive draft/validation/commit/simulation progress after excluding normal active model waits and distinct page acquisition; these are diagnosis triggers, not call/token quotas.
progress_observation.stop_rule: If original records confirm a cycle without a concrete productive next step, preserve all raw records and safely stop that run; otherwise continue. No automatic restart or old-run rewrite.
